actions.text:
Hi Marcus — thanks for reaching out and for the kind words. I’m interested and available to take this on. I can deliver a responsive React dashboard with real-time charts, role-based auth, and dark mode within your 4-week timeline. Your $5–6k budget works — I typically split work into 2 milestones (design/architecture + implementation/tests/hand-off).

A few quick questions so I can prepare a detailed proposal:
• Can you share API docs or a sample endpoint for the REST API? Are websockets available for real-time data or do you expect polling?
• Do you have a preferred charting library (D3, Recharts, Chart.js, etc.), or are you open to my recommendation for performance with large datasets?
• Any specifics on authentication (OAuth, JWT, existing identity provider) and role definitions you can share?
• Do you have design assets or should I provide UI mockups for approval before implementation?

If that sounds good, I’m happy to hop on a 30-min call to align on scope and next steps. I’m available Mon–Thu afternoons CST this week — let me know a time that works for you.

Best,
Jordan Mitchell
ML Engineer — TechCorp Inc.
